title: Casa Meyer
notes: For Barbara Meyer; his last residential project
address: Bosques de las Lomas, Mexico City

detail.intro: The last house Barragán designed, drawn in October 1978 for his friend Barbara Meyer in Bosques de las Lomas. The south and west elevations are dedicated in his hand. A private home, visited by appointment.
